scope.authority: Swift source; this JSON is generated

limitations: Lexical inventory, not a Swift compiler or a runtime appearance audit.
Comments and string literals are excluded from Swift symbol matching; embedded CSS is scanned separately.
References inside Swift string interpolation, inferred enum shorthand, type aliases, and dynamic dispatch may be absent.
UI components are declarations with listed SwiftUI/AppKit base types; extensions and indirect subclasses may be absent.
Visual expressions and local constants are review candidates; data geometry, native defaults, user colors, and email content require semantic review.
Embedded styles retain Swift interpolation and authored values; they are not a proposed app palette.
Property expressions preserve source syntax. Numeric aliases are not evaluated, and dynamic colors have no fixed hex value.
All conditional compilation branches are scanned. No build-configuration availability is inferred.
Usage counts are lexical references, including token-to-token references; zero does not prove dead code.

tokens.name: Tokens.Calendar.dayMinWidth
tokens.documentation: The narrowest a day column gets before the day and week grids scroll sideways. Seven of them and the hour gutter fit beside the sidebar in a 900 pt window.

tokens.name: Tokens.Calendar.dropHold
tokens.documentation: A dropped event stays at its new slot this long at most while its change is written.

tokens.name: Tokens.Calendar.rangeHold
tokens.documentation: The grid keeps the previous range this long while the next one loads.

tokens.name: Tokens.Calendar.sheetMinHeight
tokens.documentation: Sheets grow with their content; this keeps the editor and reviews usable when nearly empty.

tokens.name: Tokens.Calendar.startDelay
tokens.documentation: Behind Mail, Calendar starts with the first page of the list, or after this long without one.

tokens.name: Tokens.CalendarDate.monthInkBlend

tokens.name: Tokens.Compose.labeledToolbarWidth

tokens.name: Tokens.Control.listAvatar
tokens.documentation: Message list rows show a smaller disc than headers do.

tokens.name: Tokens.Control.sidebarIconScale
tokens.documentation: Sidebar symbols follow the sidebar icon size in System Settings. Apple sizes sidebar icons 16, 20 and 24 points for Small, Medium and Large, so Medium keeps a symbol's base size.

tokens.name: Tokens.Layout.columnGutter
tokens.documentation: Grab gutter beside the sidebar and the list, outside their scroll views.

tokens.name: Tokens.Layout.composeLabelWidth

tokens.name: Tokens.Layout.conversationMinWidth
tokens.documentation: A conversation in its own window keeps its header and toolbar readable.

tokens.name: Tokens.Layout.editorMinHeight
tokens.documentation: Room to write below the recipients, files and quoted text.

tokens.name: Tokens.Layout.senderMinWidth
tokens.documentation: A sender name keeps this much width before the metadata wraps below it.

tokens.name: Tokens.Motion.loadingDelay
tokens.documentation: A loading indicator waits this long, so a load that ends sooner shows none.

tokens.name: Tokens.Motion.standard
tokens.documentation: `motion.easing.standard`: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1).

tokens.name: Tokens.Opacity.outline

tokens.name: Tokens.Opacity.wash

tokens.name: Tokens.Settings.liveApplyDelay

local_visual_constants.name: AssistantMailPaneSizing.current
local_visual_constants.expression:
dividers.compactMapValues { divider -> CGFloat? in
                    guard let split = divider.split, let pane = divider.pane, split.window != nil,
                          divider.index < split.arrangedSubviews.count - 1,
                          split.arrangedSubviews[divider.index] === pane,
                          !split.isSubviewCollapsed(pane), pane.frame.width > 0 else { return nil }
                    return pane.frame.maxX
                }
